dispatches.text: Coast bar — jab, cross, empty, empty, time-and-a-half, thirty-nine bars. Same one-two, quicker slots, same empty finish.
Coast bar — jab, cross, empty, empty, double-time, thirty-nine bars. Same pair at double-time. Two fast shots, two empty slots. Stay clean.
Jab, jab, cross — time-and-a-half, thirty-one bars. Same three shots, time-and-a-half. Do not compress the last two together.
Jab, jab, cross — double-time, thirty-one bars. Same double jab, cross at double-time. Fast but readable.
Pump: body jabs only, straight time — ten bars. Close the round with body jabs. Change the target, keep the clock.
Jab, cross, lead hook — time-and-a-half, twenty-five bars. Same jab, cross, lead hook. Quicker grid, same shape.
Jab, cross, lead hook — double-time, twenty-five bars. Same three at double-time. Fast hands, empty fourth slot.
Jab, cross, lead hook, cross — straight time, thirteen bars. Add the final two and settle back into straight time.
Jab, cross, hook, cross, jab, cross, lead upper, cross!
Jab, cross, hook, cross, jab, cross, lead upper, cross!
Jab, cross, hook, cross, jab, cross, lead upper, cross!
Jab, cross, hook, cross, jab, cross, lead upper, cross!
Jab, cross, hook, cross, jab, cross, lead upper, cross!
Jab, cross, hook, cross, jab, cross, lead upper, cross!
Jab, cross, hook, cross, jab, cross, lead upper, cross!
Jab, cross, lead hook, cross — time-and-a-half, twenty-two bars. Jab, cross, lead hook, cross at time-and-a-half. Stay smooth.
Jab, cross, lead hook — double-time, twenty-two bars. Jab, cross, lead hook at double-time, then an empty slot.
Jab, cross, lead uppercut, cross — time-and-a-half, twenty-two bars. Jab, cross, lead uppercut, cross. Same rate, different finish.
Jab, jab, cross — double-time, twenty-two bars. Double jab, cross at double-time. Finish the ladder clean.
